title: Design frames manifest
description: The approval + build contract for one feature's design frames (design/frames/<feature>/manifest.json). Approving these frames approves BOTH the visual model and the build inventory (flows / components / packages), so an implementation cannot quietly invent a different architecture. NOTE: `additionalProperties` is deliberately permissive at every level — the 12 manifests on master carry feature-specific extras (`epics`, `plan`, `precedent`, `honestDegrade`, `commissionedByApproval`, `designSystemAdditions`, `missingDesignSystemPrimitives`, …). This schema pins the load-bearing shape that stamping, approval and QA depend on; it does not forbid a feature from saying more.

name.description: Human-readable feature name. Shown as the card title on the frames index.

description.description: What these frames freeze, and what approving them commits to.

designSystem.description: The design system the frames are built in. Frames use tokens only — no raw hex/spacing/type.

plan.description: Optional path/link to the planning doc this feature derives from.

stamp.description: Content stamp of design/frames/<feature>/**, DERIVED by scripts/stamp-frames.mjs — never hand-edited. Binds an approval to the exact frames the approver saw; gate-frames-stamped recomputes it, and design-approval refuses to bind to a stale stamp. Bare lowercase sha256 hex, no algorithm prefix.

entry.description: The navigable entry point for the frame set, relative to the feature dir.

frames.description: The ordered frame sequence. Each frame belongs to a flow; approval is PER FLOW (see build.flows), so one flow can be approved and implemented while its siblings still iterate.

id.description: Stable frame id, matching the file stem (e.g. '01-invoice-history').

file.description: Frame file, relative to the feature dir.

route.description: The app route this frame lands on, e.g. '/billing'.

flow.description: The build.flows[].id this frame belongs to, when a flow spans several frames.

acceptanceNotes.description: The behavioural contract QA writes RED specs against. States are contract, not decoration — cover loading/empty/error and the real fail-closed cases, not just the happy path.

testHooks.description: The data-* selectors Playwright drives. These are the stable handles between frames and specs, and must match the frame HTML exactly.

contract.description: The API/type contract these frames render against — the seam to contract-first.

openapi.description: Path to the OpenAPI spec, e.g. 'services/billing-service/openapi.yaml'.

schemas.description: The OpenAPI schema components the frames bind to.

featureFlag.description: Flag gating the feature, taxonomy '<repo>.<domain>.<flag>'. Default OFF; the builders audience must be targeted or prod-smoke can never see it.

build.description: The build inventory, rendered in index.html and mirrored here. Approving the frames approves this plan.

flows.description: Flow orchestrators to be built. Per-flow approval bookkeeping lives on these entries.

orchestrator.description: Component that orchestrates the flow, e.g. 'PasswordResetFlow'.

approved.description: Per-flow approval. Written by the design-approval workflow onto the frames PR head branch — never hand-set on master. Excluded from the stamp (see scripts/stamp-frames.mjs APPROVAL_KEYS) so approving does not invalidate the stamp it binds to.

approvedBy.description: GitHub login of the approver (must be owner/CODEOWNER). null while unapproved.

approvedAt.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or full timestamp of the approval. null while unapproved.

components.description: React components to be created. Design-system-first: missing primitives are added to the DS, not one-offed here.

packages.description: npm packages to be created/extended. Private: publishConfig → GitHub Packages, access restricted.
